title: Signals by GitDealFlow Answers
description: Q&A answer pages from Signals by GitDealFlow, AI-powered startup investment signals

items.title: How does AI score startup investment potential?
items.content_text: Signals by GitDealFlow analyzes 40+ data points, team background, market momentum, GitHub activity, hiring velocity, and funding history, to produce a composite investment signal score from 0-100.

items.title: What's a good investment signal score for early-stage startups?
items.content_text: A Signals score above 65 indicates strong early-stage potential, these startups typically show above-average team quality, market momentum, and founder track record. Scores above 80 are rare and signal exceptional opportunity.

items.title: How do VCs use Signals to screen deals?
items.content_text: VCs use Signals to triage inbound deal flow, scoring hundreds of startups automatically to surface the top 5-10% worth a partner meeting, saving 40+ hours per week on initial screening.
